name: Image Style Preview Image Manager
description: Manages a curated list of preview images (a custom config-translatable content entity) used to preview image styles on the image-style admin pages.
project_description:
This developer-oriented utility module helps sitebuilders in trying out any image style with multiple sample images, not only with that single one Drupal Core provides (the colorful hot-air balloon above the grape yards).

 Features 
 The module defines its own content entity type to allow storing, editing, and deleting multiple sample images that the sitebuilder wants to use for testing their image styles in real time. Probably most useful during the initial configuration phase of a website project, and can be disabled later on when the setup of image styles has been finished.

 Post-Installation 
 
 Go to "/admin/config/media/ispim-preview-image" and upload your preview images. 
 Go to "/admin/config/media/image-styles/" and click on the "Edit" link any of the image styles.
